title: Knowledge check: Understanding Application State

questions.prompt: Which approach best matches “Understanding Application State”?
options: New state keys may be added without declaring them in a store state.
Vuex is the default recommendation for brand-new Vue 3 projects.
Pinia stores organize shared state, derived getters, and actions under an explicit source of truth.
Pinia automatically persists all state to secure storage.
questions.answer_key: Pinia stores organize shared state, derived getters, and actions under an explicit source of truth.
questions.explanation: This answer addresses Understanding Application State directly. Verify the behavior in a small Vue 3 example and check the runtime requirements in the linked official reference.

questions.prompt: A learner example for “Understanding Application State” behaves unexpectedly. What should be checked first?
options: Reproduce the state or input change, inspect the relevant Vue binding or dependency, and compare the result with the expected output.
Change unrelated files until the page looks correct.
Disable error handling and assume the framework is at fault.
Trust a client-supplied success flag without checking behavior.
questions.answer_key: Reproduce the state or input change, inspect the relevant Vue binding or dependency, and compare the result with the expected output.
questions.explanation: Start with a small reproducible case. Inspect the element, reactive source, Console, and expected result before changing unrelated code.
